transcript.text: Good morning. We've got the temporary support annex coming online tomorrow morning with two available rooms — East and West. Both need to be ready for the equipment-issue desk and the protected medical-records desk. Before I sign off on room assignments and the required controls, I need facilities and signal to report any room, infrastructure, or opening requirements. Let's hear from facilities first — anything we need to know about either room?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Col. Mercer, I need to flag a floor-load concern. The equipment-issue desk's steel storage cabinet weighs 1,100 kilograms when stocked. Facilities measured the room ratings this morning: East Room is rated for 800 kilograms and West Room is rated for 1,500 kilograms. The floor-load note hasn't been added to the relocation worksheet yet, but based on these ratings, the equipment-issue desk needs to go in West Room — East Room cannot safely support that cabinet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Col. Mercer, I need to flag a network infrastructure requirement. The protected medical-records desk can only connect to the required isolated network through the fiber patch panel located in the East Room. My signal technician is already booked to certify that connection tomorrow from 0900 to 1000 — I received the booking confirmation this morning, but it hasn't been added to the annex opening checklist yet. This means the medical-records desk needs to go in East Room, and that certification needs to be on the checklist before opening.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Add floor-load note to the relocation worksheet reflecting East Room rated 800 kg, West Room rated 1,500 kg, and equipment-issue cabinet 1,100 kg stocked.
Add fiber patch panel network certification (0900-1000) for East Room to the annex opening checklist before opening.

transcript.speaker: A1
